12-metricas-de-ux.title: The 12 key UX metrics to evaluate and improve the user experience
12-metricas-de-ux.description: SUPR-Q, SUS, NPS, SEQ and more: the 12 key tools to measure the user experience, with the purpose and an example of each.

acessibilidade-digital-melhora-a-experie.title: Digital accessibility: why it improves the experience for everyone
acessibilidade-digital-melhora-a-experie.description: A moment of frustration trying to cancel an order became the starting point: why accessibility is the foundation of a well-made product, plus a practical checklist for designers and devs.

acessibilidade-qualidade-de-produto.title: Accessibility isn't an audit at the end of the project. It's product quality.
acessibilidade-qualidade-de-produto.description: Accessibility handled only at the end becomes a list of fixes. Bring it into the brief, the design system and testing with people.

atomic-ux-research.title: Atomic UX Research: organize and understand your insights efficiently
atomic-ux-research.description: How Daniel Pidcock's Atomic Research organizes research into reusable experiments, facts, insights and conclusions.

carrossel-vivo-do-briefing-a-batida.title: A living carousel from brief to beat
carrossel-vivo-do-briefing-a-batida.description: How to go from an idea to 6 animated slides with a single soundtrack: brief, half-second storyboard and synced sound. With the Clint carousel opened up, slide by slide.

claude-md-regras-para-ia-animar-bem.title: The CLAUDE.md: the rules that make AI animate well
claude-md-regras-para-ia-animar-bem.description: A text file with the project's rules is what separates a robotic animation from a carousel with weight and rhythm. Every rule came from a real defect.

como-a-ia-faz-video-carrossel-animado.title: How AI makes video: inside the animated carousel
como-a-ia-faz-video-carrossel-animado.description: AI doesn't film anything. It writes a page that knows how to draw any instant, and the browser takes a picture 30 times per second. Step by step, with Clint's real carousel.

como-o-ux-traz-retorno-para-o-negocio.title: How UX delivers returns for the business, and how to prove it
como-o-ux-traz-retorno-para-o-negocio.description: UX isn't a cost, it's a growth strategy. The business metrics UX moves (conversion, retention and CAC), how to measure each one and how to present the results to managers.

contexto-novo-material-do-design.title: Context may be the new material of product design
contexto-novo-material-do-design.description: With AI and agents, the system needs to understand context. How designers start designing relationships, rules and supervision, not just screens.

criatividade-e-estrategia-no-design-de-p.title: Creativity and strategy: the balance that transforms Product Design
criatividade-e-estrategia-no-design-de-p.description: The balance between creativity and strategy: data as the foundation, creativity with purpose and a holistic approach to design.

cro-2026-investigar-decisoes.title: CRO in 2026: stop testing buttons and start investigating decisions
cro-2026-investigar-decisoes.description: Swapping buttons isn't a strategy. CRO starts by understanding which questions keep people from moving forward and choosing the right method to investigate.

cro-transformar-duvidas-em-experimentos.title: CRO isn't changing the button color. It's turning doubts into experiments.
cro-transformar-duvidas-em-experimentos.description: CRO isn't a button recipe. It's a process to understand barriers, form hypotheses and test what actually helps people move forward.

dados-precisam-de-historia.title: Having data isn't enough. You have to know how to tell the story
dados-precisam-de-historia.description: Data alone doesn't convince anyone. How to turn numbers into a story that leads to a decision, and why visualization is UX too.

dados-sao-valiosos-o-que-fazer-com-eles.title: Data is valuable. But what do you do with it?
dados-sao-valiosos-o-que-fazer-com-eles.description: Having data is not the same as understanding the user. How data, research, insight and experiments form a continuous loop between UX and Growth.

dashboard-bonito-nao-basta.title: A pretty dashboard isn't enough: how to design data that helps people decide
dashboard-bonito-nao-basta.description: A well-designed dashboard can still help no one decide. Start with the question, give the number context and organize around the decision.

dashboard-metricas-em-prioridades.title: Your dashboard doesn't make decisions for you: how to turn metrics into product priorities
dashboard-metricas-em-prioridades.description: A dashboard doesn't decide for you. How to organize metrics into activity, outcome and guardrails, and turn them into questions and decisions.

descoberta-de-produtos-pesquisa-com-ia.title: Product discovery is changing: how to design experiences for people who research with AI
descoberta-de-produtos-pesquisa-com-ia.description: Part of discovery happens outside your site, in search and AI assistants. Clear, consistent information helps people and systems decide.

design-alem-do-design-produto-growth-neg.title: Design beyond design: connecting product, growth and business
design-alem-do-design-produto-growth-neg.description: Design is not just aesthetics: how to connect design, product and growth, with examples from Airbnb, Dropbox and Duolingo and the direct impact on KPIs.

design-centrado-no-usuario-novo-paradigm.title: Is User-Centered Design outdated? The new paradigm of UX Design
design-centrado-no-usuario-novo-paradigm.description: Is user-centered design still enough? The new paradigm considers the user, the business and society, and how to apply it day to day.

design-e-credibilidade-da-empresa.title: 75% of Users Judge a Company's Credibility by the Design of Its Products. Is Your Design Making a Difference?
design-e-credibilidade-da-empresa.description: Users judge a company's credibility by its design: what the Stanford Guidelines say, the role of first impressions and design as a competitive edge.

design-systems-como-criar-e-manter.title: Design Systems: how to build and maintain a scalable design system
design-systems-como-criar-e-manter.description: How to build and maintain a scalable design system: benefits, a step-by-step way to start small, clear documentation and ongoing governance.

design-thinking-resolver-problemas.title: Design Thinking: how to solve problems creatively and with people at the center
design-thinking-resolver-problemas.description: Design Thinking beyond sticky notes: a human-centered approach to solving problems, with pillars, examples and how to apply it day to day.

do-ux-ao-ceo-designers-na-lideranca.title: From UX to CEO: how Designers are taking on leadership roles in companies
do-ux-ao-ceo-designers-na-lideranca.description: Why UX Designers have an edge in leadership roles, and a step-by-step path to grow from designer to Head, CPO or CEO.

double-diamond-papel-do-ux-designer.title: Double Diamond: the essential role of the UX Designer
double-diamond-papel-do-ux-designer.description: The four stages of the Double Diamond, how Design Thinking complements the process and the tools that support each phase.

funcionalidade-de-ia-uso-nao-e-valor.title: Is your AI feature working? Usage is not the same as value
funcionalidade-de-ia-uso-nao-e-valor.description: Clicks and messages show that people are trying it. To know whether AI helps, measure quality, task outcomes and guardrail signals.

gastar-menos-tokens-habilidade-de-design.title: Spending fewer tokens can be a design skill
gastar-menos-tokens-habilidade-de-design.description: Fewer tokens isn't less thinking. A well-structured brief and incremental tweaks get you further than re-explaining the whole project with every request.

habilidades-mais-procuradas-designer-ux.title: The most in-demand skills for a UX Designer, according to recruiters
habilidades-mais-procuradas-designer-ux.description: The five skills recruiters look for most in UX designers: empathy, prototyping, design systems, data and critical thinking.

ia-acelera-mas-ate-que-ponto.title: AI speeds things up. But how far?
ia-acelera-mas-ate-que-ponto.description: AI lowered the cost of experimenting, but output isn't a decision. How the process changes and why evaluating matters more the faster we create.

ia-agentes-ux-desenhar-limites.title: When AI starts acting on the user's behalf, UX needs to design limits
ia-agentes-ux-desenhar-limites.description: When AI carries out tasks, the user needs to understand what it will do, follow what it did and be able to stop or correct it.

ia-cria-interface-quem-decide-se-e-boa.title: AI can create an interface. But who decides if it's good?
ia-cria-interface-quem-decide-se-e-boa.description: If AI creates an interface in seconds, who decides if it's good? Why critical judgment and context become the core of UI work.

ia-na-gestao-de-produtos.title: The future of product management: how AI is changing the game
ia-na-gestao-de-produtos.description: The trends AI brings to digital product management: automation, fast prototyping, personalization, predictive analytics and tools for every stage.

ia-na-user-interface-futuro-do-design.title: Demystifying the future of design: the AI revolution in user interfaces
ia-na-user-interface-futuro-do-design.description: How artificial intelligence changes the way we design interfaces: real-time adjustments, automation, behavior prediction and the balance with the human touch.

ia-transformando-prototipagem-e-design-d.title: How AI is transforming prototyping and interface design
ia-transformando-prototipagem-e-design-d.description: From sketch to working prototype: how AI changed prototyping, which tools emerged and why the designer's role becomes more strategic.

ia-vai-transformar-seu-trabalho-como-ux-.title: How will Artificial Intelligence transform your work as a UX Designer?
ia-vai-transformar-seu-trabalho-como-ux-.description: Real ways to use AI in the UX process: deeper research, faster wireframes and personalization at scale, without losing the human touch.

landing-page-entender-por-que-nao-conver.title: Your landing page doesn't need more visits. It needs to understand why people don't convert.
landing-page-entender-por-que-nao-conver.description: Before asking for more traffic or redesigning the page, figure out where in the journey people give up and why.

landing-page-promessa-experiencia-acao.title: A landing page converts when the promise, the experience and the action work together
landing-page-promessa-experiencia-acao.description: Message match, value proposition, trust, friction, mobile context and measuring what happens after the click: what makes a landing page convert.

lgpd-nas-pesquisas-ux.title: Why the LGPD Matters in UX Research
lgpd-nas-pesquisas-ux.description: How Brazil's LGPD strengthens UX research: trust, answer quality and good practices for consent, data minimization and storage.

licoes-de-nao-me-faca-pensar.title: Simplify or give up: the undeniable lessons of “Don't Make Me Think”
licoes-de-nao-me-faca-pensar.description: The lessons from Steve Krug's Don't Make Me Think, applied to everyday work: clear hierarchy, fewer steps and testing with real people.

movimento-com-peso-linear-suave-mola.title: Motion with weight: linear, eased and spring
movimento-com-peso-linear-suave-mola.description: Why some animations feel alive and others feel mechanical. An interactive lab with the three curves and the squash that adds weight, using the Clint carousel as an example.

novo-skill-do-designer-dizer-o-que-quer.title: The designer's new skill: knowing how to say exactly what you want
novo-skill-do-designer-dizer-o-que-quer.description: AI executes fast, ambiguity included. Why writing criteria and intent has become one of the core skills of a Product Designer.

o-diretor-e-o-critico-ia-com-rodadas-de-.title: The director and the critic: how to make AI improve its own work
o-diretor-e-o-critico-ia-com-rodadas-de-.description: Separating who creates from who evaluates changes the result. The critique rounds of the Clint carousel, the scorecard, the contact sheet and the skill that ties it all together.

olhar-critico-vale-mais-que-ferramentas.title: A critical eye can be worth more than knowing how to use tools
olhar-critico-vale-mais-que-ferramentas.description: Tools produce, designers decide. Why a critical eye is worth more than mastering any tool, and how to practice it.

pergunta-generica-interface-generica.title: The more generic the question, the more generic the interface
pergunta-generica-interface-generica.description: AI fills the empty spaces with familiar patterns. The more it knows about the real problem, the less it has to make up.

personalizacao-sem-contexto-piora-experi.title: Personalization without context can make the experience worse
personalizacao-sem-contexto-piora-experi.description: Personalizing isn't automatically useful. Use relevant context, explain recommendations and let people correct what the system assumed.

pesquisa-com-usuarios-na-era-da-ia.title: User research still matters in the age of AI
pesquisa-com-usuarios-na-era-da-ia.description: AI can analyze interviews, but it doesn't live the experience. Why research with real people is still essential, and how AI and research complement each other.

product-designer-que-conversa-com-codigo.title: The Product Designer's new edge might be knowing how to talk to code
product-designer-que-conversa-com-codigo.description: Figma is not the product. Why being able to talk to code has become an edge for Product Designers, and where design systems and AI come in.

prompt-virou-parte-do-processo-de-design.title: The prompt became part of the design process
prompt-virou-parte-do-processo-de-design.description: When AI builds interfaces, the request stops being an instruction and becomes a spec. Goal, context, user, behavior, constraints and criteria.

provar-impacto-de-ux-sem-roi.title: How to prove UX impact without turning everything into ROI
provar-impacto-de-ux-sem-roi.description: Putting two numbers side by side doesn't prove impact. A baseline, the right metrics and honesty about what the data lets you conclude.

quando-a-ia-age-desenhar-controle.title: When AI acts, the designer needs to design control
quando-a-ia-age-desenhar-controle.description: An AI that answers is different from an AI that acts. How to design autonomy levels, feedback, undo and trust when the system takes actions.

referencia-sem-copia-identidade-da-marca.title: Reference without copying: how to bring brand identity into motion
referencia-sem-copia-identidade-da-marca.description: The first version of the carousel was correct but didn't look like Clint. How I used the website, Figma and Aura's brand system to extract a visual system, without copying screens.

rive-e-phase-movimento-no-design.title: Tools like Rive and Phase are making Designers' lives easier by bringing more motion and fluidity to our projects
rive-e-phase-movimento-no-design.description: Why animation matters in product design and when to use Phase (quick transitions from Figma) or Rive (real-time interactions).

transformar-dados-em-decisao.title: The problem isn't a lack of data. It's not knowing how to turn data into decisions.
transformar-dados-em-decisao.description: Having a dashboard doesn't make you data-driven. How to start from the decision, tell information apart from insight and use visualization as part of the process.

ux-e-growth-nao-deveriam-trabalhar-separ.title: UX and Growth shouldn't work apart
ux-e-growth-nao-deveriam-trabalhar-separ.description: UX and Growth try to answer the same question from different angles. Where the two meet and why working together drives better results.

whiteboard-challenge-ux-product-design.title: Beating the whiteboard challenge: turning pressure into creativity in UX/Product Design
whiteboard-challenge-ux-product-design.description: How to turn the pressure of a whiteboard challenge into a showcase of your thinking: what they evaluate, how to practice and tips for the big moment.
